title: 餐厅点餐
goal: 会订位、点菜、说忌口和过敏，听懂服务员的询问，会结账和分开付。
tips: 美国说 check，英国说 bill：Could we have the check / bill, please?
美国餐厅一般要付 15%–20% 小费（tip），很多欧洲国家不强制。
欧洲餐厅的水通常要钱，想要免费的自来水就说 tap water, please.

exchanges.reply: No, we don't. A table for two, please.
Not yet. Could we have a few more minutes?
exchanges.replyZh: 还没有。能再给我们几分钟吗？

exchanges.hearZh: 要无气矿泉水还是气泡水？

exchanges.hear: How would you like your steak?
Can I get you anything else? Some dessert?
exchanges.hearZh: 还需要别的吗？来点甜点？
exchanges.reply: No, thanks. Could we have the check, please?
exchanges.replyZh: 不用了，谢谢。可以结账吗？

lines.en: Right this way. Here are your menus. Can I get you something to drink?
lines.zh: 这边请。这是菜单。先给您上点喝的吗？

lines.en: Just water for now, thanks. What do you recommend?
lines.zh: 先来点水就行，谢谢。你们推荐什么？

lines.en: Our grilled salmon is very popular, and the beef stew is great too.
lines.zh: 我们的烤三文鱼很受欢迎，炖牛肉也很好吃。

lines.en: We'll have one salmon and one beef stew. Is the stew spicy?
lines.zh: 我们要一份三文鱼和一份炖牛肉。炖牛肉辣吗？

lines.en: No, not at all. Any allergies I should know about?
lines.zh: 一点也不辣。有什么需要注意的过敏吗？

lines.en: No, thanks. That's all for now.
Excuse me, could we have the check, please?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我们可以结账吗？

lines.en: Sure. Is this together or separate?
lines.zh: 好的。一起付还是分开付？

lines.en: Together. Can I pay by card?
Of course. I'll bring the card machine.
lines.zh: 当然，我把刷卡机拿过来。
